additional_limitations: The existing authored loader embeds the descriptive case ID in agent-visible source identifiers. Names including changed-duplicate-conflict and changed-missing-certificate provide categorical task hints. The expected numeric values and the identity of the missing-certificate lot were not supplied except through ordinary raw evidence. Future independently designed benchmarks should use neutral identifiers.

This pilot therefore supports exploratory observations about the current system on these four tasks; it is not an independently validated accuracy score. Original attempts, fixtures and same-model grades remain unchanged.
